Recorded claim:
tb-tools D320309 review history records that `resizeDirection` is the resized-pane axis while `aria-orientation` is the perpendicular separator axis; an explanatory comment was applied locally and focused ESLint plus `git diff --check` passed. For typematic Arrow resizing, keep every size delta but emit start/resizing once and `splitter-resize-end`/`splitter-resized` once on keyup or blur, matching the mouse lifecycle. The preview's lifecycle assertion passed, but two new width/value assertions failed (`expected 160`, `actual 230`); resolve the test/setup discrepancy before treating the lifecycle change as validated. A later Patch Update stopped on uncommitted `comm` changes. This is recorded patch-update context, not independently revalidated source evidence. [ad-hoc note]
